name: catalog-data
description: catalog.data.gov is the U.S. government's open-data catalog (about 587k datasets from federal, state and local publishers). This CLI searches datasets, pages through results, reads dataset metadata and download links, fetches raw DCAT records, and lists organizations, publishers and keywords.

commands.name: search-datasets
commands.summary: Search the Data.gov catalog for datasets, with optional keyword tag, organization type, publisher, geospatial and downloadable-file filters, and sorting.

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text search query

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: relevance, popularity or last_harvested_date. The UI also offers a fourth option (likely distance), which was not tested.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Exact keyword tag filter, e.g. 'ev' or 'powerball'. Use suggest-keywords to find valid tags.

params.name: org_type
params.description: Organization type filter, e.g. 'Federal Government' or 'State Government'. Values match organization_type in list-organizations.

params.name: publisher
params.description: Exact publisher name. Use list-publishers to find names.

params.name: spatial_filter
params.description: Restrict to geospatial or non-geospatial datasets. Leave unset for all.

params.name: has_download
params.description: true = only datasets with a downloadable file

commands.name: search-datasets-next
commands.summary: Fetch the next page of dataset search results (the 'Show more results' fragment) using an 'after' cursor from a previous results page.

params.name: after
params.description: Opaque base64 cursor taken from the previous results page's 'Show more results' link

params.name: q
params.description: The same search query as the original search

params.name: sort
params.description: The same sort as the original search: relevance, popularity or last_harvested_date

params.name: keyword
params.description: The same keyword tag filter as the original search

params.name: org_type
params.description: The same organization type filter as the original search

params.name: publisher
params.description: The same publisher filter as the original search

params.name: spatial_filter
params.description: The same geospatial filter as the original search

params.name: has_download
params.description: The same downloadable-file filter as the original search

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page

params.name: results
params.description: Number of results already shown, used for rank numbering, e.g. 40

commands.name: get-dataset
commands.summary: Get one dataset's metadata (title, description, publisher, dates, license, keywords) and its download links (distribution) by slug.

params.name: slug
params.description: Dataset slug: the last part of a /dataset/<slug> URL, without any ?from_hint=... suffix

commands.name: get-harvest-record
commands.summary: Get the raw DCAT JSON metadata record for a dataset by its harvest record UUID (linked from the dataset page).

params.name: id
params.description: Harvest record UUID

commands.name: list-organizations
commands.summary: List all publishing organizations (124) with slug, type and dataset count, as JSON.

commands.name: list-publishers
commands.summary: List the top publishers by dataset count (100 of 1867); names can be used as the publisher filter.

commands.name: suggest-keywords
commands.summary: Autocomplete keyword tags matching a partial string, with dataset counts; results can be used as the keyword filter.

params.name: search
params.description: Partial keyword text

params.name: size
params.description: Maximum number of suggestions

commands.name: search-organizations
commands.summary: Browse or search organizations by name (HTML listing with type and dataset count, paginated).

params.name: q
params.description: Organization name search text

params.name: per_page
params.description: Organizations per page

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1

commands.name: get-organization-datasets
commands.summary: List or search the datasets of one organization (by slug), with optional publisher and geospatial filters and sorting.

params.name: slug
params.description: Organization slug, e.g. energy, census, noaa, washington (see list-organizations)

params.name: q
params.description: Search text within this organization's datasets

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: relevance, popularity or last_harvested_date

params.name: publisher
params.description: Exact publisher name within the organization

params.name: spatial_filter
params.description: Restrict to geospatial or non-geospatial datasets

notes: Dataset result URLs look like /dataset/<slug>?from_hint=...; strip the query string and pass only <slug> to get-dataset.
There is no known query parameter for filtering the main search by organization (organization=epa was ignored). Use get-organization-datasets with the organization slug instead.

The search pages return 15–20 results. More results come from search-datasets-next with an 'after' cursor that is embedded in the previous page's 'Show more results' link. That cursor's CSS location was not captured, and old cursors may expire. Repeat the same q, sort and filter values as the original search.
get-dataset returns the page's schema.org JSON-LD; distribution[].contentUrl holds the direct download links (CSV, JSON, XML, etc.) on the source portals.
The harvest record UUID for get-harvest-record is linked from the dataset HTML page (the 'raw' metadata link); it is not included in the JSON-LD.
list-publishers returns only the top 100 of about 1867 publishers; no paging parameter for it was observed.
Geographic bounding-box filtering and distance sort exist in the UI but their parameters were not captured.
